nodes.label: Esri
nodes.description: Commercial GIS vendor behind the ArcGIS platform and the original Shapefile format.

nodes.label: ArcGIS Online
nodes.description: Esri's cloud GIS for hosting feature and tile layers, web maps and apps, with basemaps and geocoding APIs.

nodes.label: ArcGIS Pro
nodes.description: Esri's flagship 64-bit desktop GIS for 2D/3D mapping, editing and geoprocessing, scriptable with ArcPy.

nodes.label: ArcGIS Enterprise
nodes.description: Self-hosted ArcGIS server stack (portal, server, data store) for publishing map, feature and imagery services.

nodes.label: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript
nodes.description: Esri's web mapping SDK for 2D maps and 3D scenes backed by ArcGIS services.

nodes.label: ArcGIS Living Atlas
nodes.description: Curated collection of maps, imagery, demographic and environmental layers shared through ArcGIS.

nodes.label: ArcGIS Feature Service (REST)
nodes.description: Esri's REST API for querying and editing hosted vector feature layers, widely consumed by third-party clients.

nodes.label: Esri Leaflet
nodes.description: Leaflet plugins for ArcGIS basemaps, feature layers and services.

nodes.label: Mapbox
nodes.description: Location platform offering vector-tile basemaps, styling, geocoding, navigation and mobile/web SDKs.

nodes.label: Mapbox GL JS
nodes.description: WebGL map renderer for vector tiles and Mapbox styles; source-available since v2 under Mapbox terms.

nodes.label: Mapbox Studio
nodes.description: Browser-based editor for designing Mapbox map styles and managing tilesets.

nodes.label: Mapbox Tiling Service
nodes.description: Managed pipeline that converts large vector datasets into hosted Mapbox vector tilesets.

nodes.label: Mapbox GL Draw
nodes.description: Drawing and editing controls for Mapbox GL JS and MapLibre GL JS maps.

nodes.label: Google Maps Platform
nodes.description: Google's Maps, Routes, Places and Photorealistic 3D Tiles APIs and SDKs.

nodes.label: HERE Platform
nodes.description: HERE Technologies' location platform with map data, routing, geocoding and fleet APIs.

nodes.label: TomTom Maps APIs
nodes.description: TomTom's maps, search, routing and traffic APIs built on its Orbis map.

nodes.label: CARTO
nodes.description: Cloud-native spatial analytics platform that runs directly on data warehouses such as BigQuery and Snowflake.

nodes.label: Felt
nodes.description: Collaborative web GIS for uploading data, styling maps and sharing them; maintains Tippecanoe.

nodes.label: Google Earth Engine
nodes.description: Planetary-scale platform for analysing satellite imagery and geospatial datasets with JavaScript or Python.

nodes.label: Microsoft Planetary Computer
nodes.description: Petabyte-scale catalog of environmental data in cloud-native formats, searchable via a STAC API.

nodes.label: Sentinel Hub
nodes.description: Satellite imagery processing APIs (OGC and custom) on Sentinel, Landsat and commercial data; part of Planet.

nodes.label: Planet
nodes.description: Operator of the largest Earth-observation constellation, delivering daily imagery through APIs.

nodes.label: Amazon Location Service
nodes.description: AWS managed maps, places, routes and geofencing APIs with MapLibre-based client SDKs.

nodes.label: Azure Maps
nodes.description: Microsoft Azure's mapping, search, routing and weather APIs with a Web SDK.

nodes.label: Cesium ion
nodes.description: Hosted platform that tiles and streams 3D content (terrain, imagery, photogrammetry, BIM) as 3D Tiles.

nodes.label: Fused
nodes.description: Serverless platform for running Python geospatial UDFs over cloud-native data and serving results as tiles.

nodes.label: Wherobots
nodes.description: Managed spatial compute cloud from the creators of Apache Sedona for large-scale vector and raster analytics.

nodes.label: BigQuery GIS
nodes.description: Geography types and functions inside Google BigQuery, backed by spherical S2 geometry.

nodes.label: Source Cooperative
nodes.description: Neutral, non-profit data publishing utility for sharing cloud-native geospatial datasets over S3.

nodes.label: OpenFreeMap
nodes.description: Free, open-source hosted OpenStreetMap vector-tile basemaps with no API keys or limits.

nodes.label: Protomaps
nodes.description: Open-source basemap system built on single-file PMTiles archives that can be served from plain object storage.

nodes.label: MapTiler
nodes.description: Map hosting and APIs with vector basemaps, geocoding and a MapLibre-based SDK.

nodes.label: Stadia Maps
nodes.description: Hosted basemaps, geocoding and routing built on open-source projects like Valhalla and Pelias.

nodes.label: QGIS
nodes.description: Leading free and open-source desktop GIS for viewing, editing, analysing and cartography, extensible with Python plugins.

nodes.label: GDAL
nodes.description: The Geospatial Data Abstraction Library: translator library for 200+ raster and vector formats underpinning most GIS software.

nodes.label: OGR
nodes.description: The vector half of GDAL: simple-features drivers for reading and writing vector formats and databases.

nodes.label: gdal_translate
nodes.description: Converts raster data between formats, subsets and rescales; commonly used to produce COGs.

nodes.label: gdalwarp
nodes.description: Reprojects, mosaics and warps raster images.

nodes.label: ogr2ogr
nodes.description: Swiss-army knife for converting, filtering and reprojecting vector data between formats and databases.

nodes.label: gdalinfo
nodes.description: Prints metadata, georeferencing and band statistics for a raster dataset.

nodes.label: ogrinfo
nodes.description: Lists layers, fields and features of a vector dataset, with SQL query support.

nodes.label: gdal (unified CLI)
nodes.description: GDAL 3.11+ single `gdal` command with consistent subcommands and pipelines, complementing the classic utilities.

nodes.label: PROJ
nodes.description: Coordinate transformation library and CRS database used by virtually every open-source GIS tool.

nodes.label: GEOS
nodes.description: C/C++ computational geometry engine (a port of JTS) providing predicates and overlay operations.

nodes.label: JTS Topology Suite
nodes.description: Java library of 2D spatial predicates and functions; the reference implementation GEOS is ported from.

nodes.label: Tippecanoe
nodes.description: Builds vector tilesets from large GeoJSON, FlatGeobuf or CSV collections with smart feature dropping.

nodes.label: PMTiles CLI (go-pmtiles)
nodes.description: Go tool to convert, inspect, extract and serve PMTiles archives.

nodes.label: Planetiler
nodes.description: Fast Java tool that generates planet-scale vector tilesets from OpenStreetMap and other sources in hours.

nodes.label: Osmium Tool
nodes.description: Command-line tool for filtering, extracting and converting OpenStreetMap data files.

nodes.label: PDAL
nodes.description: Point Data Abstraction Library: GDAL-like pipelines for translating and processing point clouds.

nodes.label: GRASS
nodes.description: Long-running open-source GIS engine for raster, vector and time-series analysis; also a QGIS processing provider.

nodes.label: SAGA GIS
nodes.description: System for Automated Geoscientific Analyses with hundreds of terrain and raster modules.

nodes.label: WhiteboxTools
nodes.description: Rust geospatial analysis toolkit with 450+ tools for hydrology, terrain and LiDAR processing.

nodes.label: JOSM
nodes.description: Extensible Java desktop editor for OpenStreetMap, favoured by power mappers.

nodes.label: iD
nodes.description: Browser-based OpenStreetMap editor that is the default editor on openstreetmap.org.

nodes.label: Maputnik
nodes.description: Free visual editor for MapLibre and Mapbox style JSON that runs in the browser.

nodes.label: MapLibre
nodes.description: Community organisation maintaining open-source map renderers and specs forked from Mapbox's BSD code.

nodes.label: MapLibre GL JS
nodes.description: Open-source WebGL map renderer forked from Mapbox GL JS v1, with globe and terrain support.

nodes.label: MapLibre Native
nodes.description: C++ vector map renderer for iOS, Android, desktop and server-side rendering.

nodes.label: Leaflet
nodes.description: Lightweight, mobile-friendly JavaScript library for raster-tile interactive maps with a huge plugin ecosystem.

nodes.label: React Leaflet
nodes.description: React components that wrap Leaflet maps and layers.

nodes.label: OpenLayers
nodes.description: Full-featured web mapping library with deep support for OGC services, projections and GeoTIFF.

nodes.label: deck.gl
nodes.description: GPU-powered framework for large-scale data visualization layers on top of base maps.

nodes.label: CesiumJS
nodes.description: WebGL virtual globe and 3D mapping library, the reference client for 3D Tiles.

nodes.label: kepler.gl
nodes.description: Browser app and React framework for exploratory analysis of large location datasets, built on deck.gl.

nodes.label: Turf.js
nodes.description: Modular geospatial analysis for JavaScript operating on GeoJSON.

nodes.label: Terra Draw
nodes.description: Map-library-agnostic drawing toolkit with adapters for MapLibre, Leaflet, OpenLayers, Google Maps and more.

nodes.label: loaders.gl
nodes.description: Framework-agnostic loaders for geospatial, 3D and tabular formats, used by deck.gl and kepler.gl.

nodes.label: react-map-gl
nodes.description: React wrapper for MapLibre GL JS and Mapbox GL JS.

nodes.label: Observable Plot
nodes.description: Concise grammar-of-graphics charting library with first-class geo marks and projections.

nodes.label: d3-geo
nodes.description: D3 module for map projections, spherical geometry and SVG/Canvas path generation.

nodes.label: Three.js
nodes.description: General-purpose WebGL/WebGPU 3D library, used for custom 3D layers and 3D Tiles rendering in geo apps.

nodes.label: Lonboard
nodes.description: Jupyter widget for fast visualization of millions of features using deck.gl and GeoArrow.

nodes.label: GeoPandas
nodes.description: Extends pandas with geometry columns and spatial operations for tabular vector analysis.

nodes.label: Shapely
nodes.description: Python bindings to GEOS for planar geometry manipulation with vectorized operations.

nodes.label: Fiona
nodes.description: Pythonic API over OGR for reading and writing vector data feature by feature.

nodes.label: Pyogrio
nodes.description: Vectorized, bulk-oriented vector I/O for GeoPandas built on GDAL/OGR; GeoPandas' default engine.

nodes.label: Rasterio
nodes.description: Clean Python API for reading and writing gridded raster data via GDAL.

nodes.label: Xarray
nodes.description: N-dimensional labelled arrays for climate, Earth-observation and other multidimensional data.

nodes.label: rioxarray
nodes.description: Xarray extension adding CRS handling, reprojection and GeoTIFF I/O powered by Rasterio.

nodes.label: PyProj
nodes.description: Python interface to PROJ for CRS definitions and coordinate transformations.

nodes.label: Folium
nodes.description: Generates interactive Leaflet maps from Python data.

nodes.label: Datashader
nodes.description: Rasterizes billions of points or geometries into images for faithful large-data visualization.

nodes.label: Leafmap
nodes.description: Jupyter mapping toolkit with multiple backends (ipyleaflet, folium, MapLibre) and minimal code.

nodes.label: geemap
nodes.description: Interactive Jupyter mapping and analysis for Google Earth Engine.

nodes.label: Cartopy
nodes.description: Matplotlib-based cartographic projections and map plotting for scientific figures.

nodes.label: OSMnx
nodes.description: Downloads, models and analyses street networks and other features from OpenStreetMap.

nodes.label: PySAL
nodes.description: Python Spatial Analysis Library for spatial statistics, econometrics and clustering.

nodes.label: PySTAC
nodes.description: Python library for reading, writing and validating STAC catalogs, collections and items.

nodes.label: rio-tiler
nodes.description: Creates map tiles and previews from COGs and other rasters on the fly.

nodes.label: TorchGeo
nodes.description: PyTorch domain library with geospatial datasets, samplers and pretrained models for Earth observation.

nodes.label: segment-geospatial (SAMGeo)
nodes.description: Applies Meta's Segment Anything models to satellite and aerial imagery.

nodes.label: DuckDB Spatial
nodes.description: DuckDB extension adding geometry types, GEOS functions and GDAL-backed I/O to the in-process analytical database.

nodes.label: Apache Sedona
nodes.description: Cluster computing system for large-scale spatial data on Spark, Flink and Snowflake.

nodes.label: sf (R)
nodes.description: Simple Features for R: the standard R package for vector data, binding GDAL, GEOS, PROJ and s2.

nodes.label: terra (R)
nodes.description: R package for fast raster and vector data manipulation and analysis, successor to raster.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.description: Advanced open-source relational database and the host for PostGIS.

nodes.label: PostGIS
nodes.description: Spatial extension for PostgreSQL providing geometry, geography and raster types with hundreds of functions.

nodes.label: SQLite
nodes.description: Embedded single-file SQL database engine underlying GeoPackage and MBTiles.

nodes.label: SpatiaLite
nodes.description: Spatial SQL extension for SQLite, a lightweight file-based counterpart to PostGIS.

nodes.label: GeoServer
nodes.description: Java server for publishing geospatial data through OGC standards such as WMS, WFS, WMTS and OGC API.

nodes.label: MapServer
nodes.description: Fast C map rendering server publishing OGC WMS, WFS, WCS and OGC API services.

nodes.label: Martin
nodes.description: Blazing-fast Rust tile server for PostGIS, PMTiles and MBTiles sources.

nodes.label: pg_tileserv
nodes.description: Minimal Go server that publishes PostGIS tables and functions as vector tiles.

nodes.label: pg_featureserv
nodes.description: Lightweight Go server exposing PostGIS data through OGC API - Features.

nodes.label: Tegola
nodes.description: Go vector tile server with PostGIS and GeoPackage providers and tile caching.

nodes.label: TileServer GL
nodes.description: Serves MBTiles/PMTiles vector tiles and renders them to raster with MapLibre Native.

nodes.label: TiTiler
nodes.description: FastAPI-based dynamic tile server for Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs, STAC items and mosaics.

nodes.label: Terracotta
nodes.description: Lightweight Python XYZ tile server for COG collections.

nodes.label: pygeoapi
nodes.description: Python server implementing the OGC API family (Features, Maps, Tiles, Processes, Records).

nodes.label: OSRM
nodes.description: Open Source Routing Machine: very fast C++ shortest-path routing engine on OpenStreetMap data.

nodes.label: Valhalla
nodes.description: Tiled, multimodal routing engine with dynamic costing, isochrones and map matching.

nodes.label: GraphHopper
nodes.description: Java routing engine for OpenStreetMap with custom models, isochrones and map matching.

nodes.label: openrouteservice
nodes.description: Routing, isochrone and matrix service built on GraphHopper and OpenStreetMap.

nodes.label: Nominatim
nodes.description: OpenStreetMap's official geocoder for forward and reverse search, backed by PostGIS.

nodes.label: Pelias
nodes.description: Modular Elasticsearch-based geocoder combining OSM, OpenAddresses and Who's On First.

nodes.label: Photon
nodes.description: Search-as-you-type geocoder for OpenStreetMap data built on OpenSearch.

nodes.label: GeoJSON
nodes.description: JSON encoding for geographic features (RFC 7946), the lingua franca of web mapping.

nodes.label: TopoJSON
nodes.description: GeoJSON extension that encodes shared topology, giving much smaller files for boundaries.

nodes.label: Shapefile
nodes.description: Esri's 1990s multi-file vector format; ubiquitous but limited (2 GB, 10-char field names).

nodes.label: GeoPackage
nodes.description: OGC SQLite-based container for vector features, tiles and attributes in a single file.

nodes.label: KML
nodes.description: XML format from Google Earth for placemarks and overlays, now an OGC standard.

nodes.label: FlatGeobuf
nodes.description: Streamable binary vector format with a spatial index enabling HTTP range-request queries.

nodes.label: GeoParquet
nodes.description: Specification for storing geometries in Apache Parquet, enabling fast columnar analytics on vector data.

nodes.label: GeoArrow
nodes.description: Specification for geometry in Apache Arrow memory, enabling zero-copy exchange between tools.

nodes.label: PMTiles
nodes.description: Single-file archive of map tiles readable via HTTP range requests, with no tile server required.

nodes.label: MBTiles
nodes.description: SQLite-based container for tilesets, the classic format for offline and server-side tiles.

nodes.label: COG (Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF)
nodes.description: GeoTIFF with internal tiling and overviews so clients can fetch just the bytes they need; an OGC standard.

nodes.label: GeoTIFF
nodes.description: TIFF with embedded georeferencing tags; the most common raster interchange format.

nodes.label: Zarr
nodes.description: Chunked, compressed N-dimensional array storage designed for object stores.

nodes.label: GeoZarr
nodes.description: Emerging OGC convention for geospatial metadata and multiscales in Zarr.

nodes.label: NetCDF
nodes.description: Self-describing multidimensional array format widely used for climate and ocean data.

nodes.label: STAC
nodes.description: SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog: JSON spec and API for describing and searching geospatial assets.

nodes.label: MVT (Mapbox Vector Tile)
nodes.description: Protobuf encoding for tiled vector data; the de-facto vector tile standard.

nodes.label: MapLibre Tile (MLT)
nodes.description: Emerging column-oriented vector tile format from MapLibre with better compression and faster decoding than MVT.

nodes.label: Mapbox Style Spec
nodes.description: JSON document describing sources, layers and expressions for Mapbox GL renderers.

nodes.label: MapLibre Style Spec
nodes.description: Open evolution of the Mapbox Style Spec used by MapLibre GL JS and MapLibre Native.

nodes.label: OGC API - Features
nodes.description: Modern RESTful/JSON successor to WFS for serving vector features.

nodes.label: OGC API - Tiles
nodes.description: OGC API standard for serving vector and map tiles, the successor to WMTS.

nodes.label: OGC API - Maps
nodes.description: OGC API standard for rendered map images, the successor to WMS.

nodes.label: WMS
nodes.description: OGC Web Map Service: returns rendered map images for a bounding box.

nodes.label: WFS
nodes.description: OGC Web Feature Service: XML/GML-based querying and transactions on vector features.

nodes.label: WMTS
nodes.description: OGC Web Map Tile Service for pre-rendered, cacheable map tiles.

nodes.label: Simple Features (WKT/WKB)
nodes.description: OGC/ISO model for points, lines and polygons with WKT/WKB encodings used across spatial databases.

nodes.label: CRS / EPSG Registry
nodes.description: Authoritative registry of coordinate reference systems and transformations (e.g. EPSG:4326).

nodes.label: H3
nodes.description: Uber's hierarchical hexagonal discrete global grid for indexing and aggregating location data.

nodes.label: S2 Geometry
nodes.description: Google's spherical geometry library and hierarchical cell index based on a cube projection.

nodes.label: Geohash
nodes.description: Base-32 string encoding of latitude/longitude into a hierarchical grid of rectangles.

nodes.label: A5
nodes.description: Emerging equal-area pentagonal discrete global grid system for spatial indexing.

nodes.label: LAS / LAZ
nodes.description: ASPRS binary format for LiDAR point clouds; LAZ is its lossless compressed variant.

nodes.label: COPC (Cloud Optimized Point Cloud)
nodes.description: LAZ file organised as a clustered octree so point clouds can be streamed via range requests.

nodes.label: 3D Tiles
nodes.description: OGC community standard for streaming massive heterogeneous 3D content such as buildings and photogrammetry.

nodes.label: I3S (Indexed 3D Scene Layers)
nodes.description: Esri-originated OGC community standard for streaming 3D scene layers.

nodes.label: Cloud-Native Geospatial Forum
nodes.description: Community and forum (CNG) promoting cloud-native formats such as COG, GeoParquet, STAC and PMTiles.

nodes.label: Open Geospatial Consortium
nodes.description: International consortium that develops open geospatial standards like WMS, GeoPackage and OGC API.

nodes.label: OSGeo
nodes.description: Open Source Geospatial Foundation, the umbrella for projects like QGIS, GDAL, PROJ, GEOS and PostGIS.

nodes.label: Overture Maps Foundation
nodes.description: Linux Foundation project (founded by Amazon, Meta, Microsoft and TomTom) building interoperable open map data.

nodes.label: Overture Maps data
nodes.description: Monthly global map releases distributed as GeoParquet on S3 and Azure, with stable GERS IDs.

nodes.label: Overture: Addresses
nodes.description: Overture theme of address points aggregated from open government sources.

nodes.label: Overture: Base
nodes.description: Overture theme of land, water, land use and infrastructure for basemap context.

nodes.label: Overture: Buildings
nodes.description: Conflated building footprints from OSM, Microsoft, Google and others, some with heights.

nodes.label: Overture: Divisions
nodes.description: Administrative boundaries and named places such as countries, regions and localities.

nodes.label: Overture: Places
nodes.description: Tens of millions of points of interest contributed by Meta, Microsoft and others.

nodes.label: Overture: Transportation
nodes.description: Global road and path network with connectors suited to routing.

nodes.label: OpenStreetMap
nodes.description: The crowd-sourced, openly licensed map of the world and the base for countless maps and services.

nodes.label: Natural Earth
nodes.description: Public-domain small-scale cultural and physical vector and raster data at 1:10m–1:110m.

nodes.label: Foursquare Open Source Places
nodes.description: 100M+ global points of interest released by Foursquare as open Parquet data.

nodes.label: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints
nodes.description: Over a billion building footprints extracted from imagery with deep learning.

nodes.label: Google Open Buildings
nodes.description: Building footprints across Africa, Asia and Latin America detected from high-resolution imagery.

nodes.label: USGS / Landsat
nodes.description: 50+ years of moderate-resolution Earth observation imagery, distributed free as COGs with STAC metadata.

nodes.label: Copernicus / Sentinel
nodes.description: EU Copernicus Sentinel missions providing free radar and multispectral imagery via the Copernicus Data Space.
nodes.license: Copernicus free, full and open data policy

nodes.label: US Census TIGER/Line
nodes.description: US Census Bureau boundaries, roads and address ranges released as public-domain shapefiles.

nodes.label: Mapillary
nodes.description: Crowd-sourced street-level imagery platform with machine-derived map features, owned by Meta.
